class.name: NNTimeSinceBehaviourSensor
class.brief_description: Scores how long it has been since a specific [NNBehaviour] last ran.
class.description: Outputs [code]0.0[/code] while [member behaviour] is running, then rises linearly to [code]1.0[/code] over [member duration] seconds of agent time (and starts at [code]1.0[/code] before the behaviour has ever run). Use this as a soft cooldown or boredom curve so a behaviour becomes gradually more attractive the longer it has been neglected (or invert its consideration curve to favor repeating recent behaviours). For a hard lockout, use [member NNBehaviour.cooldown_seconds] instead.

members.member: The [NNBehaviour] to watch. Scores [code]0.0[/code] if unset.
Seconds of agent time after the behaviour ends until the sensor reaches [code]1.0[/code].
